vetSays.line: 🛡️ Kofi, Javier, Danylo and Meruert met them at the door — 4 put down. Kofi, Javier, Meruert are hurt.
🛡️ Kofi, Danylo, Olivia and Nino met them at the door — 4 put down. Kofi, Danylo, Olivia, Nino are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Kofi, Danylo, Meruert and Nino met them at the door — 4 put down. Kofi, Danylo, Meruert, Nino are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Boris just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Kofi, Danylo, Nino and Ruth met them at the door — 2 put down, 2 barely walked away. Kofi, Danylo, Nino, Ruth are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Boris just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Kofi just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Kofi, Danylo, Meruert and Olivia met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Danylo, Meruert, Olivia are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ruth just put down Big Ugly... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
Ruth strikes the Scarred Loud-Eyes.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
The Scarred Loud-Eyes falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Scarred Loud-Eyes!
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ruth just put down Ugly-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. A Elder veteran.
The Elder The Ugly Beast falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Elder The Ugly Beast!
SYSTEM: "That was... a lot. The producers say the ratings were historic. I don’t know what to do with that sentence."
🛡️ Daniyar met them at the door — 1 put down.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.

regDeaths.name: the absence of sound, shaped like wings
a raccoon with too many fingers, working at something
a drumbeat with no drummer, getting closer
something wearing a crown of bone, bellowing at the dusk
a soft green glow under the water
